name: Mouse Trail Drop
description: Full-screen dark section where moving the mouse or finger spawns images that pop in, fall with a bounce and drop off screen, over a centered two-line title.
contents: Centered two-line title with separate colors
Pool of images spawned along the pointer path
behavior: Spawns an image after the pointer travels a set distance
Each image pops with elastic scale, falls, bounces sideways and exits, then is removed
Images cycle in order through the list
Works with touch via touchstart and touchmove
Image size switches to the mobile size at 768px and below
editableByProps: Title text and colors, background color
Image list, size, radius and spawn distance
Easing and durations of the drop animation

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the exit fall and sideways travel multipliers

fixed: Section is full viewport height (h-dvh) and clips overflow
Spawn distance is based on window width at mount
